name: Spire Plus
author: wenhuorongbing-netizen
description: Spire Plus is a single Slay the Spire 2 gameplay expansion for private testing. Enable this one mod to test inspectable Ancient relic rewards, selected vanilla relic revisions, preview tools, and A11-A20 test rules: Blight Sprouts, Rootblight, Firemarked Elites, Banner Rooms, boss dedicated abilities, Crystal Sphere peek, and transform preview. Seedbed plants pollution out of the current combat; Planting is not play, discard, or exhaust. Requires BaseLib. 中文：Spire Plus 是用于私测的《杀戮尖塔 2》单体玩法扩展。启用这一个 Mod，可以测试先古之民遗物奖励、原版遗物调整、预览工具和 A11-A20 测试进阶。苗床会把污染牌种下：移出本场战斗，不算打出、弃牌或消耗；根芽等同本战已处理，根蚀只在本战停住。
